label: Verified Esmeralda deposit-masking runs

chainRecord.settlementAmountVisibility: Not revealed in public transaction fields
chainRecord.depositVisibility: Not revealed in the tested claim-free open, settlement, or refund transaction fields

refundRecord.testDescription: Separate fresh channel; refunded by the payer after expiry

notes: One HTTP /fortune request was accepted off-chain for 10 µT and settled in one finalized transaction.
The serialized settlement had no covenant claims and revealed no plaintext input or output amounts; the channel deposit, service amount, and payer remainder were masked from transaction fields.
The separate expired-channel payer refund also finalized with zero covenant claims, zero revealed input amount, and no revealed output amount.
The chain confirms transaction finality and fee. The call and accepted amount come from the local service ledger, not a chain proof.
The deposit amount and fee are omitted here; fees, timing, branch, opaque channel id, authorization data, output commitments, and output count remain public.
This is a static evidence record; follow the linked Esmeralda explorer transactions to inspect live chain data.
